paper.title: The association of diabetes and anti-diabetic medications with clinical outcomes in multiple myeloma.

source.title: The association of diabetes and anti-diabetic medications with clinical outcomes in multiple myeloma.

study.design: Single-center retrospective MM clinical cohort with overlapping observational antidiabetic treatment classes
study.diabetesDefinition: HxD: type2 diabetes or routine antidiabetic treatment at MM diagnosis/presentation; SID: noHxD and >=2 random glucose>200mg/dL or antidiabetic medication after glucocorticoid MM therapy
study.drugExposureDefinition: Use at presentation or subsequently changed/added, regardless of dose or duration; five overlapping user/nonuser categorical attributes
outcomes: Death with progressive MM versus death without progressive MM as competing events
study.statistics: KM/logrank unless indicated,Cox proportional hazards, Fine-Gray competing risks; no causal identification established
study.ethics: MD Anderson IRB approval, no protocolID/consent waiver detail identified in main

populations.exclusions: Type1 diabetes, MM diagnosis>6months before presentation,incomplete records,not primary oncology institution; per-reason N not reported

results.outcome: Diabetes status and induction complete remission
Antidiabetic drug exposure and overall survival in diabetic MM
Diabetes status and death with progressive MM
Antidiabetic drugs and death with progressive MM

claims.statement: Diabetes status and induction complete remission. Observational association with exact adjusted/unadjusted differences, nulls and source qualifications retained; no causal treatment effect.
Diabetes status and overall survival. Observational association with exact adjusted/unadjusted differences, nulls and source qualifications retained; no causal treatment effect.

Antidiabetic drug exposure and overall survival in diabetic MM. Observational association with exact adjusted/unadjusted differences, nulls and source qualifications retained; no causal treatment effect.
Diabetes status and death with progressive MM. Observational association with exact adjusted/unadjusted differences, nulls and source qualifications retained; no causal treatment effect.
Antidiabetic drugs and death with progressive MM. Observational association with exact adjusted/unadjusted differences, nulls and source qualifications retained; no causal treatment effect.

reviewInputs.answer: Association of HxD/SID and actual antidiabetic use with MM clinical outcomes.
Humans with newly diagnosed MM, diabetes subgroups not general diabetes/prevention population.
Five overlapping antidiabetic categories including actual metformin and insulin/analogues.
ND/HxD/SID and user/nonuser of each class, overlapping drug indications.
Primary OS; inductionCR and death-with-progressive-MM competing outcomes.

reviewInputs.answer: Metformin OS association with adjusted progression-death association but unadjusted null/later landmark nonsignificance; diabetes/insulin associations not causal.

sourceQualifications.description: 1240 identified/reviewed but1083 analyzed after exclusions, not1240 final. ND603/HxD136/SID344, diabetes480 derived. Median age57 and tertiary referral center limit generalizability; per-exclusion counts and complete missing-data flow unavailable.

SID is post-glucocorticoid operational classification, not randomized diabetes causation. Median SID discovery159days and metformin record175days after MM diagnosis as reported; SID group defined after time zero creates timing/selection concerns. EarlierSID45.5 versus59.9months P.008 is main narrative of unread supplement, not a separately audited cohort.

Drug users include baseline or later added/changed medication regardless of dose/duration. Five overlapping class flags, not mutually exclusive monotherapy/randomized assignment. Exact dose, adherence, start/stop history and main drug-specific exposed Ns absent; no verified time-updated causal treatment analysis.

InductionCR29/136HxD,70/344SID,173/603ND P.003; adjusted diabetesOR.672 P.008 with source reversed CI.901-.501 retained, not silently repaired. SCT OR4.324CI2.475-7.575P<.001 is observational. This diabetes-status comparison is not metformin-specific CR benefit.

CombinedDM medianOS65.4 versusND98.7months. SID62.8 P<.001 but HxD69.8 P.0593 versusND; adjusted SIDHR1.619CI1.328-1.972P<.001/HxD.943CI.688-1.295P.718. Do not claim both diabetes types independently worsen OS.

Abstract lists age among multivariate predictors, but Table2 age>65HR.786CI.605-1.023P.073, contrasting univariate older-age disadvantage. Body lists SCT alongside decreased OS despite Table2HR.351CI.278-.442 and prior sentence improved. Retain directional/source conflict without reversing model coding.

Metformin-user medianOS74.3 versus60.1months, textP.034 versus Figure2EP.036 unresolved. AdjustedHR.658CI.479-.902P.009, not a66% mortality reduction or causal anticancer effect. Drug-specific Ns/event counts/median CIs not in main.

Insulin/analogue medianOS57 versus101months P<.001, adjustedHR1.810CI1.352-2.423P<.001. Secretagogues.899CI.652-1.239P.515,TZD1.412CI.888-2.246P.145,others.943CI.341-2.604P.909 are null/inconclusive, not equivalence or class-wide metformin benefit. TZD Figure2FP.057 is univariate, not adjustedP.145.

DrugOS Table3 adjusts ISS/Chr14/SCT/CCI and five overlapping drug flags; no age/sex/race/glucose covariates displayed in this drug model. Table2 broader model is different. Diabetes severity/insulin resistance, treatment selection, renal function, therapy era and SCT selection remain confounding, not erased by adjustment.

55 diabetic renal-insufficiency patients, none prescribed metformin; source defines baseline creatinine<1.5mg/dL literally despite renal-insufficiency label. Excluding them metforminOS P.039 as narrative of uncheckedS3; no corrected threshold or independent HR invented. Restriction does not establish removal of all renal/indication confounding.

Main narrative reports metforminOS landmark3/6/9/12m P.012/.022/.039/.029, but exact risk-set Ns, HRs/CIs, medication classification and supplement details unchecked. Significant landmarks do not prove absence of immortal-time bias or causal benefit from ever-use exposure.

Death with progressive MM is last-record disease-status surrogate for cancer-specific cause, not adjudicated death due to MM or PFS. Fine-Gray competing events distinct from all-cause Cox hazard; no exact event Ns/cumulative risks at fixed times digitized.

DM associated with death with progressiveMM unadjustedP<.001; HxDP.034/SIDP<.001 separately. Main-reported adjusted DMHR1.346CI1.207-1.501P<.001, stageHR1.142CI1.008-1.295P.037 and SCT.647CI.476-.879P.005 reference uncheckedS5. No DM association with death without progression; not no comorbidity harm.

Unadjusted metformin/secretagogue/TZD/other death-with-progression comparisons are nonsignificant. Adjusted main-reported metforminHR.663CI.452-.975P.037 and insulinHR1.562CI1.122-2.174P.008 do not replace unadjusted null. Insulin unadjustedP.007. No classes significantly change death without progression, data not shown.

Death-with-progression metformin landmarks3/6/9/12m P.041/.027/.053/.054; latter two nonsignificant and weaker than OS. Authors call near/borderline significant, not promoted to positive or proof all immortal-time concerns excluded. FullS6 models unchecked.

Table1 SID Chr14 translocation20(58%) literal percentage mismatch retained; no correction to5.8. Bibliographic Huang2011 is gastric cardiac staging and Wentholt2008 glucose-monitor accuracy despite cancer-drug context citations, so their cited clinical support is unverified, not silently replaced. Other cancer/ALL and receptor-cell studies not this cohort results.

Authors explicitly state no causal relationship can be established. No randomized metformin efficacy, insulin-caused cancer harm, medication change instruction, optimal insulin-sparing regimen or clinical safety proof. Adverse drug events, hypoglycemia/lactic acidosis and withdrawals not systematically reported here, not zero.

MDACC IRB approval withoutID/explicitconsent details. KomenKG081048/NCI P50CA142509/CA16672, Fujian training/Xiamen3502z20077042/WQK0605 grants; authors declare no conflict. Main9pages and tables1-3/Fig1-3 read. Supplementary tables/figure, rawdata/protocol/current integrity unchecked, no acquisition.
